ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen to the phytoplankton if krill increased?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows a simple ocean food chain, with phytoplankton (phytoplankton) at the bottom, krill (krill) above, and baleen whale (baleen whale) at the top. The arrows point from phytoplankton to krill, and then from krill to baleen whale, indicating that energy or food relationships are passed upward. Reasoning: Because krill feed on phytoplankton, if the number of krill increases, there will be more krill eating phytoplankton, so the number of phytoplankton will decrease.
